title: Manual Therapy
shortDesc: Hands-on mobilization and soft-tissue techniques to relieve pain and restore joint movement.
longDesc: Manual therapy uses skilled, hands-on techniques — joint mobilization, manipulation, and soft-tissue release — to reduce pain, ease stiffness, and restore natural movement. Our therapists assess how your joints and muscles work together, then apply targeted treatment to address restrictions at their source. Combined with guided exercise, it accelerates recovery from injury, post-surgical stiffness, and everyday aches, helping you move freely and comfortably again.

title: Sports Rehabilitation
shortDesc: Performance-focused recovery to get athletes safely back to training and competition.
longDesc: Sports rehabilitation helps athletes of every level recover from injury and return to peak performance. We combine clinical assessment, progressive strength and conditioning, and movement retraining to rebuild power, agility, and confidence. Whether you're managing a sprain, recovering from surgery, or correcting biomechanics to prevent re-injury, your program is measured objectively and progressed as you improve — so you return to sport stronger and with a lower risk of setback.

title: Orthopedic Physiotherapy
shortDesc: Targeted rehab for bone, joint, and post-surgical recovery to restore strength and mobility.
longDesc: Orthopedic physiotherapy treats conditions affecting bones, joints, ligaments, and muscles — from fractures and arthritis to post-operative recovery. We design progressive programs that rebuild strength, flexibility, and stability while protecting healing tissue. Working closely with your surgeon or physician when needed, we focus on restoring full function with the least invasive path possible, so you can return to daily activities and movement without pain or limitation.

title: Neuro Rehabilitation
shortDesc: Specialized recovery programs for stroke, spinal, and neurological conditions.
longDesc: Neurological rehabilitation supports people recovering from stroke, spinal-cord injury, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's, and other conditions affecting the nervous system. Through repetitive task training, balance and gait re-education, and functional exercises, we help restore movement, coordination, and independence. Every plan is tailored to your goals and progress, with close coordination across your care team to maximize recovery and quality of life over the long term.

title: Geriatric Physiotherapy
shortDesc: Gentle, age-appropriate care to keep older adults mobile, balanced, and independent.
longDesc: Geriatric physiotherapy addresses the unique needs of older adults — managing arthritis, osteoporosis, balance problems, and reduced mobility. We focus on fall prevention, strength and endurance, and safe, confident movement so you can stay active and independent. With gentle, individualized programs and clear guidance for everyday activities, we help reduce pain and maintain the freedom to do the things that matter most, at any age.

title: Pediatric Physiotherapy
shortDesc: Play-based therapy to support children's movement, development, and milestones.
longDesc: Pediatric physiotherapy helps infants, children, and adolescents reach their movement and developmental milestones. We treat conditions such as developmental delay, cerebral palsy, torticollis, and post-injury recovery using playful, child-centered techniques that keep young patients engaged. Working alongside parents and caregivers, we build practical home programs that turn therapy into everyday play — supporting strength, coordination, and confidence as your child grows.

title: Women's Health
shortDesc: Specialized physiotherapy for pre/post-natal care, pelvic health, and recovery.
longDesc: Women's health physiotherapy provides specialized care across every life stage — pregnancy and post-natal recovery, pelvic-floor dysfunction, incontinence, and post-surgical rehabilitation. Through individualized assessment and targeted exercise, we address pain, weakness, and functional concerns with discretion and expertise. Our goal is to help you feel strong, comfortable, and confident in your body, with support tailored sensitively to your needs and goals.

title: Pain Management
shortDesc: Evidence-based therapies to relieve chronic pain and restore everyday function.
longDesc: Our pain management program helps people living with chronic or persistent pain regain control and function. Combining manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, posture and movement re-education, and modalities such as electrotherapy, we address both the source of pain and its impact on daily life. Through education and a graded, sustainable plan, we help reduce reliance on medication and build lasting strategies so you can return to the activities you value.

title: Cupping Therapy
shortDesc: Traditional cupping techniques to relieve muscle tension, improve circulation, and support recovery.
longDesc:
Our cupping therapy treatments combine traditional techniques with modern rehabilitation principles to help reduce pain, release muscle tightness, improve blood circulation, and promote natural healing. Cupping can be beneficial for individuals experiencing muscular discomfort, sports-related fatigue, postural strain, and restricted movement. Each session is tailored to your specific needs and may be used as a standalone treatment or alongside physiotherapy for enhanced recovery and wellness.

Services include:
• Full Body Cupping
• Upper Back Muscle Cupping
• Lower Back Muscle Cupping
• Both Upper Limb Cupping
• Lower Limb Cupping
• Facial Cupping (for Acne and Beauty Purposes)

title: Dry Needling
shortDesc: Targeted needling techniques to relieve muscle pain, reduce tension, and restore movement.
longDesc:
Our dry needling treatment is designed to address muscle pain, tightness, and movement restrictions caused by trigger points and muscular dysfunction. Using fine, sterile needles, our therapists target specific muscle knots and areas of tension to promote relaxation, improve blood flow, reduce pain, and enhance overall mobility. Dry needling is commonly used for sports injuries, neck and back pain, shoulder dysfunction, headaches, and chronic muscular conditions. Each treatment is carefully tailored to your condition and may be combined with physiotherapy exercises and manual therapy for optimal recovery and long-term results.

Conditions commonly treated include:
• Neck Pain and Stiffness
• Upper Back and Shoulder Pain
• Lower Back Pain
• Muscle Tightness and Trigger Points
• Sports Injuries and Muscle Strains
• Headaches Related to Muscle Tension
• Tennis Elbow and Other Overuse Injuries
• Postural Dysfunction and Movement Restrictions
